sources.title: Llama 3.1 8B | Robots Atlas
sources.snippet: Llama 3.1 8B is an open-weight language model developed by Meta, released on 23 July 2024 as part of the Llama 3.1 family. It is an auto-regressive, decoder-only Transformer model with 8 billion parameters.
